design_gotchas.title: EN Sequencing Limit (VEN <= VIN + 0.3 V) & Unlimited PMOS Reverse-Current Body Diode
design_gotchas.detail: Footnote 3 on Page 4 caps EN absolute maximum voltage at min(VIN + 0.3 V, 6.0 V), meaning an always-on host GPIO cannot drive EN high before VIN powers up (unlike TPS7A02/TPS7A20/TLV755P). Section 7.3.1 (p.11) also warns that the PMOS pass transistor body diode conducts unlimited reverse current if VOUT > VIN; externally limit reverse current to <= 5% of rated IOUT (15 mA).

design_gotchas.title: High 249.2 °C/W SOT-23-5 RθJA Prevents Sustained 300 mA From 5 V Input
design_gotchas.detail: At VIN = 5.0 V to VOUT = 3.3 V and full 300 mA load, power dissipation is 0.51 W. With DBV RθJA = 249.2 °C/W (p.4), ΔT reaches 127.1 °C — exceeding the 125 °C continuous TJ limit even at 25 °C ambient. Restrict 5 V-to-3.3 V continuous load to ~200 mA at 25 °C (or ~90 mA at 85 °C) unless using Li-Ion 3.7–4.2 V input or enhanced PCB copper. Note also Table 6.5 dropout is 260 mV typ / 375 mV max vs 220 mV headlined on Page 1.

design_gotchas.title: No Internal Active Output Discharge on TLV70233DBVR (Requires 'P' Suffix TLV70233PDBVR)
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike TLV70233PDBVR (top marking 'SLH'), the non-P TLV70233DBVR (top marking 'QVD') omits the 120 Ohm active pulldown MOSFET (p.3, p.5, p.11). When EN goes low under light load, VOUT decays slowly through leakage alone, which can upset MCU brownout/POR sequencing if replacing an active-discharge LDO such as AP2127K or TPS7A05P.

design_gotchas.title: Pin 4 NC Thermal Grounding Conflicts With BYP/NR LDOs & 0.1 uF Effective Cap Floor
design_gotchas.detail: Page 3 allows tying Pin 4 (NC) to GND for thermal relief, but doing so prevents later drop-in substitution of Pin-4 BYP/NR LDOs (e.g., TPS793 legacy chip, LP2985, AP2210K). Also Section 8.2.2.1 (p.13) cautions that a nominal 0.1 uF ceramic cap does NOT guarantee stability after DC-bias derating; use >= 1 uF X5R/X7R with ESR < 200 mOhm.

typical_use_cases: Single-cell Li-Ion (3.6 V–4.2 V) to 3.3 V power rails for BLE/ZigBee/Wi-Fi modules up to 300 mA
Compact handheld and wearable sub-rails benefiting from 0.1 uF minimum effective output capacitance
Low-noise 3.3 V sensor and RF front-end supplies leveraging 68 dB PSRR (1 kHz) and 48 uVRMS noise
Candidate drop-in second source on standard 5-pin SOT-23-5 (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=NC, 5=OUT) boards
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV70233DBVR is a 300 mA fixed 3.3 V (±2% over -40°C to +125°C) low-IQ PMOS LDO in a 5-pin DBV SOT-23-5 package (1=IN, 2=GND, 3=EN active high, 4=NC, 5=OUT). Operating from 2.0 V to 5.5 V (6.0 V abs max), it delivers 35 uA no-load IQ (370 uA at 300 mA), 260 mV typical / 375 mV max dropout at 300 mA, 68 dB PSRR at 1 kHz, 48 uVRMS output noise, and stability down to 0.1 uF effective ceramic capacitance (1 uF nominal recommended, ESR < 200 mOhm). Key design constraints include its 249.2 °C/W DBV RθJA, VEN <= VIN + 0.3 V sequencing rule, lack of reverse-current blocking, and absence of active output discharge on this non-P OPN.
